team.name: Dr. Micah Craig, M.D.
team.bio: Internal Medicine physician and Medical Director specializing in regenerative medicine, longevity science, and medical aesthetics, dedicated to evidence-based, whole-person care.
bioFull: Dr. Micah Craig’s journey into medicine began at age five, walking hospital corridors alongside his father, a devoted physician. Those early moments ignited a lifelong calling rooted in healing and human connection. Throughout his undergraduate years, he spent summers on medical mission trips across Africa and Central America — experiences that grounded his commitment to compassionate, service-driven care. After earning his degree, he deepened his scientific foundation with a Master’s in Biochemistry before entering medical school with a clear vision: practice medicine that is both evidence-based and deeply personal.

During his Internal Medicine residency in Denver, Dr. Craig served on the frontlines of the COVID-19 pandemic, navigating the ICU in one of the most demanding periods in modern medicine. That experience sharpened his clinical instincts and revealed the limitations of reactive care — and drove him toward a different approach. He immersed himself in regenerative medicine, longevity science, and aesthetic therapies, pursuing advanced training in ozone therapy, IV therapy, peptide protocols, HBOT, GLP-1 weight management, and medical aesthetics. In 2024, he founded RAVE: Regenerative Aesthetics & Vitality Experts — a clinic built to fuse internal wellness with aesthetic medicine under one integrated roof.

Now serving as Medical Director at OVI Wellness, Dr. Craig brings that same philosophy to our clinic community. He provides medical oversight across all clinical services — from ozone and IV hydration therapy to exosome treatments, peptide protocols, and regenerative aesthetics — ensuring every protocol meets the highest standards of patient-centered, evidence-based care.
team.philosophy: Real transformation happens when you treat the whole person — inside and out. True healing combines rigorous evidence-based science with deep human connection and personalized preventive care.
associations: Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) — Internal Medicine Residency, Denver, CO

team.name: Sean Worix, PA-C
team.bio: Four years of experience across family and integrative medicine, blending evidence-based primary care with advanced strategies in hormone optimization, metabolic health, and longevity-focused medicine.
bioFull: Sean Worix, PA-C, is passionate about helping patients achieve lasting improvements in health through precision medicine, preventive care, and individualized treatment plans. With four years of experience spanning family medicine and integrative medicine, he blends a strong foundation in evidence-based primary care with advanced strategies in hormone optimization, metabolic health, and longevity-focused medicine.

After graduating summa cum laude from West Virginia University with a degree in Exercise Physiology, Sean continued his education at South University–Tampa, earning his Master of Science in Physician Assistant Studies, also summa cum laude. His background in human performance and clinical medicine allows him to develop comprehensive treatment plans that address the underlying drivers of health while helping patients improve energy, body composition, cognitive performance, and overall well-being.

At OVI Wellness, Sean is committed to delivering personalized, compassionate care built on scientific evidence, transparency, and long-term partnerships—empowering every patient to optimize not only how they feel today, but how they age for decades to come.
team.philosophy: True health optimization isn't about chasing laboratory values—it's about restoring function, improving quality of life, and helping patients perform at their highest potential through personalized, evidence-based medicine.
